clue.text: Relaxed time — unknown in TV hospital drama

parts.note: relaxed and informal
T is the abbreviation for time
algebra uses x, y and z for unknowns

explanation.surface: A laid-back stretch of time somewhere in a hospital show on television.
explanation.walkthrough: CASUALTY is the long-running BBC drama set in a hospital's emergency department.
explanation.definitionFit: Casualty is the title of a British television series set in an accident and emergency unit.

clue.text: Disorganised coach is confused about it on reflection

indicators.note: a reflection in a mirror shows things back to front, so the small word it is turned round
about means surrounding, so the jumbled letters go around the other piece
something confused has its parts jumbled, so the vehicle's letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A muddled sports coach is puzzled when thinking things over.
explanation.walkthrough: The jumbled coach letters wrap around the backward pronoun.
explanation.definitionFit: Chaotic and disorganised are synonyms, both describing a state lacking any order.

clue.text: Choice of three directions given under oath

wordplay.note: a choice among three compass points

explanation.surface: Someone testifying in court must pick between three ways to go.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'choice' supplies the word OR between the last two compass points: S, W OR N.
explanation.definitionFit: Sworn testimony is evidence that has been given after taking a formal oath.

clue.text: High cynical tone confused

indicators.note: confused letters are mixed up, so the two words before are rearranged

parts.note: fodder taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone high on something speaks in a muddled, cynical way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'High' looks like an intoxicated state; in weather forecasting a high is an area of high pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: An anticyclone is a weather system of high atmospheric pressure, which forecasters simply call a high.

clue.text: Drink — mine is raised on request mostly

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece sitting on another means it comes first
in a down clue raising something lifts it bottom to top, so it reads backwards

parts.note: a coal mine is a pit

indicators.note: mostly means not all of it, so the final letter is dropped

parts.note: a plea is an earnest request

explanation.surface: A toast where the host raises a glass of something on demand.
explanation.definitionFit: A tipple is an informal word for an alcoholic drink, especially a person's usual one.

clue.text: Woodwind instrument made from old tree trunk, not large

parts.note: O is the abbreviation for old

indicators.note: not means without, so the following letter is taken away

parts.note: the bole is the trunk of a tree
L is the abbreviation for large, as on clothing sizes

explanation.surface: A wind instrument carved out of an ancient, slender tree trunk.
explanation.definitionFit: The oboe is a double-reed member of the woodwind family of the orchestra.

clue.text: Left out, in flower and growing rapidly

indicators.note: out means removed, so the letter it follows is taken away

parts.note: flowering plants are blooming
L is the abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: A plant left outside comes into flower and shoots up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Left out' reads as abandoned outdoors; it is an instruction to drop one letter from the word the next words give.
explanation.definitionFit: A booming economy or trade is one growing quickly and strongly.

clue.text: Wear from some bolero designer

indicators.note: the answer comes from some of the letters of the next words, lying inside them

parts.note: the letters run across the two words

explanation.surface: Garments to wear by a designer who makes short jackets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wear' looks like clothing but is the verb, to wear away. A bolero is a short open jacket.
explanation.definitionFit: To erode something is to wear it away gradually, as water does to rock.

clue.text: Approve party in apartment

indicators.note: one thing in another sits inside it, so the second word wraps the first

parts.note: APT is the abbreviation for apartment
a do is a party

explanation.surface: Giving permission for a party to be held in a flat.
explanation.definitionFit: To adopt a proposal, such as a committee report, is to formally approve or accept it.

clue.text: Choose a deep sounding type of flute

indicators.note: sounding tells us to say the phrase out loud and listen

parts.note: choose is pick, and a deep note is a low one

explanation.surface: Choosing a flute with a deep sound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Deep sounding' looks like it describes the flute, which is ironic: this one is the highest-pitched.
explanation.definitionFit: The piccolo is a small flute pitched an octave above the standard concert flute.

clue.text: Policeman penning note such as could be disputed

indicators.note: penning means shutting in, as animals in a pen, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: a constable is a police officer
te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: An officer writing a note whose contents someone could argue with.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Penning' looks like writing; it means enclosing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something contestable is open to challenge or argument, so it could be disputed.

clue.text: Titanium used with new metal

parts.note: Ti is the chemical symbol for titanium
N is the abbreviation for new

explanation.surface: Titanium being combined with a novel metal in an alloy.
explanation.definitionFit: Tin is a soft silvery chemical element classed among the metals.

clue.text: Flowering plant is decennial unusually

indicators.note: done unusually means not in the normal way, so the letters are put in a different order

parts.note: fodder taken as written

explanation.surface: A plant that oddly blooms only once every ten years.
explanation.walkthrough: Decennial means happening every ten years.
explanation.definitionFit: The celandine is a small yellow-flowered plant of the buttercup or poppy family.

clue.text: Opening tea — nice exporting India!

parts.note: cha is a slang word for tea

indicators.note: exporting sends something out, so that letter leaves the word

parts.note: taken as written
India is I in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A tea trader opens a business, glad to be sending goods out of India.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Opening' reads as the start of something; here it is an opportunity.
explanation.definitionFit: A chance is an opportunity or opening, as in 'an opening for a new player'.

clue.text: Football team's magazine

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the north London Premier League club
second meaning: a store of weapons and ammunition

explanation.surface: The programme or fanzine published by a football club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Magazine' suggests a publication, but it is the military sense, a store of arms.
explanation.definitionFit: Arsenal is an English football club, and an arsenal is a stockpile of weapons, like a military magazine.

clue.text: Hound British bird of prey

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for British
the eagle is a large bird of prey

explanation.surface: Pestering a British raptor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hound' looks like a verb meaning harass; it is the noun, a hunting dog.
explanation.definitionFit: The beagle is a small breed of hunting dog, a scent hound used to chase hares.

clue.text: English make an impression with beheading sovereign

indicators.note: beheading cuts off the head, so the first letter is removed

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for English
to impress is to make an impression

explanation.surface: An English monarch who left her mark by having people executed.
explanation.definitionFit: An empress is a female emperor, a ruling monarch or sovereign.

clue.text: Snapper in river a long time

parts.note: the Cam is the river through Cambridge
an era is a long period of time

explanation.surface: A snapping turtle or fish living in a river for ages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Snapper' suggests a fish or turtle; it is something that snaps photographs.
explanation.definitionFit: A camera takes snaps, so it is playfully called a snapper.

clue.text: Clashing with stand-in — so unfortunately

indicators.note: something going unfortunately has gone wrong, so the letters end up out of order

parts.note: fodder taken as written

explanation.surface: Falling out with a substitute, as things went badly.
explanation.definitionFit: Dissonant sounds or ideas clash with each other, lacking harmony.

clue.text: Misleading attraction of Christmas month initially over year

parts.note: Dec is the abbreviation for December

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of the word that follows

parts.note: the opening letter of over
Y is the abbreviation for year

explanation.surface: A seasonal lure at the start of December that lasts the year.
explanation.definitionFit: A decoy is a lure or bait used to draw someone or something into a trap.

clue.text: Exercises taking power and energy

indicators.note: taking means adding on, so the next piece joins after the first

parts.note: PE is physical education, school exercises
P is the symbol for power in physics

explanation.surface: Physical workouts demand strength and stamina.
explanation.definitionFit: Pep is liveliness or vigour, an informal word for energy and spirit.

clue.text: Quiet chap in post office

indicators.note: a man in a building is inside it, so the name sits within the other piece

parts.note: PO is the abbreviation for post office
Ian is a man's name, standing for any chap

explanation.surface: A silent man standing in a post office queue.
explanation.walkthrough: Piano is the musical direction meaning play softly.
explanation.definitionFit: In musical scores piano, marked p, instructs players to perform softly.

clue.text: Admit cipher is broken by one crew regularly

indicators.note: something broken by another is split open with the other placed inside

parts.note: a cipher is a secret code

indicators.note: regularly means at even intervals, so every second letter is taken

parts.note: the second, fourth and sixth letters

explanation.surface: Confessing that a secret code has been cracked by a single team.
explanation.definitionFit: To concede is to admit or acknowledge that something is true, often reluctantly.

clue.text: Support book event

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for book
a race is a sporting event

explanation.surface: Backing an event by booking it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Book event' reads like reserving a place; the words are taken separately.
explanation.definitionFit: A brace is a strut or support that holds something firm.

clue.text: What finishes off lazy bistro who'll cook egg only partly

indicators.note: what finishes a word is its final letter, so the ends of the next words are taken

parts.note: the closing letter of each of the four words

explanation.surface: A lazy restaurant cook who only half-cooks the eggs.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition sits at the end: the yellow centre is just part of an egg.
explanation.definitionFit: The yolk is the yellow inner part of an egg, so it is an egg only in part.

clue.text: Voracious bird round United States

parts.note: the raven is a large black bird
O is round in shape
US is the abbreviation for United States

explanation.surface: A greedy bird travelling around America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Round' looks like it means encircling; here it just supplies the circle-shaped letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Ravenous means extremely hungry, which is the same as voracious.
